# JARNet

A community for researchers with ties to Japan and Austria to meet across fields, institutions, and career stages, exchange practical knowledge, and open doors to new collaboration.

::: {.landing-section}
## A Place to Connect Across Fields

JARNet brings together Japanese researchers and researchers with ties to Japan, especially those working in Austria. Our members span the natural sciences, engineering, humanities and social sciences, music, the arts, and other fields.
:::

::: {.landing-grid}
::: {.landing-card}
### Connect

Meet researchers across disciplines and institutions through informal gatherings, seminars, and networking events.
:::

::: {.landing-card}
### Share

Exchange information on funding, calls, systems, research environments, and day-to-day research life in Austria.
:::

::: {.landing-card}
### Co-create

Turn new contacts and shared ideas into collaborations and exchanges.
:::
:::

::: {.landing-section .landing-section-split}
::: {.landing-section-copy}
## Joining the Network

JARNet welcomes researchers currently based in Austria, those who have spent time here before, and researchers working in neighboring Central European countries.
:::
